units.rawText: Kaede-sama brought the village's mikos to the high ground further up the mountain. The other villagers were enthralled by the village chief and refused to leave.

units.rawText: This Kimie wanted to save everyone, so I took that miko's place to fill the breach in the dam.

spans.text: This Kimie wanted to save everyone, so I took that miko's place to fill the breach in the dam.

units.rawText: But in the end, I could not contend against the power of nature and the flood washed everything away.
units.displayText: But in the end, I could not contend against the power of nature and the flood washed everything away.

spans.text: But in the end, I could not contend against the power of nature and the flood washed everything away.

units.rawText: To this day, I do not know if I did the right thing by deceiving that miko in the name of the kami, or by attempting to deceive the kami by using myself to fill the breach.

units.rawText: The shrine is painted a hazy orange. Warmth is everywhere, and the gentle wind blows the leaves past their hair. This is the first time Kimie has seen the shrine like this, whether in reality or on the cloud.

units.rawText: The beauty and ugliness, the light and the dark of the world, all of these can be portrayed in stories. And she will be the witness, the audience surrogate for all of creation.
